statement: I believe great technology should make people’s financial lives simpler, faster, and more secure — and I’ve spent 19 years working to prove it.
bio: I am a driven Senior Team Leader with over 19 years of experience in the banking sector and a proven track record of success, including managing top-notch implementations of banking financing modules across Lebanon and Jordan.

Throughout my career I have led mission-critical projects spanning mobile banking platforms, treasury management systems, trade finance workflows, check clearing infrastructure, and Islamic banking portals — always focused on stability, scalability, and real-world impact for the thousands of customers and branch staff relying on those systems every day.

Reliable, trustworthy, and hardworking, I remain eager to learn new skills and stay ahead of the rapid evolution of banking technologies. Whether leading a cross-functional team or diving deep into a technical challenge, I approach every task with the same level of care and commitment.
